Source: After the Tidal Rift, islands that reshape themselves rose in the open ocean, home to great reptiles thought long gone and unfamiliar plants.
en-us: After the Tidal Rift, islands that reshape themselves rose in the open ocean, home to great reptiles thought long gone and unfamiliar plants.
ko-kr: 「조수 균열」 이후 대양 한가운데에 지형이 수시로 바뀌는 섬들이 떠올랐다. 그곳에는 사라졌다고 여겨진 거대한 파충류와 낯선 식물이 산다.

Source: You crew a civilian Searoute Company ship, mapping unfamiliar islands and raising camps for the patrons who fund the voyage.
en-us: You crew a civilian Searoute Company ship, mapping unfamiliar islands and raising camps for the patrons who fund the voyage.
ko-kr: 당신은 섬을 조사하고 후원자를 위해 정착지를 세우는 민간 선단, 항로단의 일원이다.

Source: Sells maps and sea lanes for profit.
en-us: Sells maps and sea lanes for profit.

Source: Turns island materials into new crafts.
en-us: Turns island materials into new crafts.

Source: Every rock you chart is a rock somebody pays for. Bring me landmarks.
en-us: Every rock you chart is a rock somebody pays for. Bring me landmarks.
ko-kr: 네가 지도에 올린 바위마다 값을 치를 사람이 있지. 눈에 띄는 지점을 가져와.

Source: Good material, honest work. Show me what this island can become.
en-us: Good material, honest work. Show me what this island can become.
ko-kr: 좋은 재료에 정직한 솜씨. 이 섬이 무엇이 될 수 있는지 보여 줘.

Source: Watch first, touch later. The island remembers who was gentle.
en-us: Watch first, touch later. The island remembers who was gentle.
ko-kr: 먼저 지켜보고, 손은 나중에. 섬은 누가 조심스러웠는지 기억해.

Source: Hull's patched, sails are dry. Where to this time?
en-us: Hull's patched, sails are dry. Where to this time?
ko-kr: 선체 수리 끝, 돛도 말랐어. 이번엔 어디로 가나?

Source: Three fresh contracts on the board today. First come, first paid.
en-us: Three fresh contracts on the board today. First come, first paid.
ko-kr: 오늘 게시판에 새 의뢰가 셋. 먼저 온 사람이 먼저 받아 가지.

Source: Claim a settlement plot and place a Workbench
en-us: Claim a settlement plot and place a Workbench

Source: The tide carried you here. Skip any time.
en-us: The tide carried you here. Skip any time.
ko-kr: 물때가 당신을 이곳에 데려왔다. 언제든 건너뛸 수 있다.

Source: Walk up to a fallen trunk and gather.
en-us: Walk up to a fallen trunk and gather.

Source: Open crafting and make a Flint Hatchet.
en-us: Open crafting and make a Flint Hatchet.
ko-kr: 제작 창을 열고 부싯돌 손도끼를 만들자.

Source: Choose a spot and claim your settlement.
en-us: Choose a spot and claim your settlement.

Source: Accept your first contract and deliver it.
en-us: Accept your first contract and deliver it.

Source: Your camp is standing at last, and the next island is out there.
en-us: Your camp is standing at last, and the next island is out there.

Source: Food from the campfire fills you up far more than raw forage.
en-us: Food from the campfire fills you up far more than raw forage.
ko-kr: 모닥불에서 만든 음식은 날것보다 훨씬 든든하다.

Source: Bellowers warn before they charge. Step aside when the ground flashes.
en-us: Bellowers warn before they charge. Step aside when the ground flashes.
ko-kr: 울림이는 돌진하기 전에 경고한다. 땅이 번쩍이면 옆으로 피하자.

Source: Stone walls need a Mason's Bench, and the bench needs timber beams.
en-us: Stone walls need a Mason's Bench, and the bench needs timber beams.
ko-kr: 석재 벽은 석공대가 필요하고, 석공대는 각재가 필요하다.

Source: Marsh clay turns into brick only in a Mud Kiln.
en-us: Marsh clay turns into brick only in a Mud Kiln.

Source: Grazers run from you. Hunters warn you. Learn the difference.
en-us: Grazers run from you. Hunters warn you. Learn the difference.
ko-kr: 풀뜯이는 도망치고 사냥꾼은 경고한다. 그 차이를 익히자.

Source: Your camp holds up to four members. Build together, keep together.
en-us: Your camp holds up to four members. Build together, keep together.
ko-kr: 캠프에는 최대 네 명까지 들어온다. 함께 짓고 함께 지키자.

Source: Couldn't reach another island. You'll stay here for now.
en-us: Couldn't reach another island. You'll stay here for now.
ko-kr: 다른 섬으로 이동하지 못했어요. 지금은 이 섬에 머무릅니다.

Source: Travel is taking longer than expected. Trying again shortly.
en-us: Travel is taking longer than expected. Trying again shortly.
ko-kr: 이동이 지연되고 있어요. 잠시 후 다시 시도합니다.
